name: Nucleide
tagline: A fast, open-source nuclear engineering toolkit in Rust with Python bindings.
description:
Nucleide is a modern Rust toolkit for nuclear-engineering workflow glue: legacy transport-code I/O, nuclide identification, materials, CRAM depletion, and enrichment analytics — exposed through a typed Python API.

The project is a fresh Rust implementation of capabilities pioneered by [PyNE](https://github.com/pyne/pyne), focused on memory safety, fast builds, and pip install-able wheels. Scope is intentionally narrow today and will expand as more parsers and workflow pieces land.
